name: Structure Budget
description: Keeps the structure from turning into overhead: a rule, record or sub-intent is admitted only with what it prevents, and what stops paying is pruned, by weighing what the structure costs each change against what it catches.
purpose: Keep the structure's own cost in view: admit a rule, record or sub-intent only with what it prevents, and prune what stops paying.
approach: Admit a rule only with the mistake it prevents and evidence that it still catches something; weigh the effort the structure adds to each change against the real mistakes it catches, and remove what catches nothing.
out_of_scope: Removing what still catches real mistakes; running the rules.
milestones: 1. Structure cost against catches: the time the check adds and the real violations it caught, recorded over a month.
measures_of_success: Small changes stay small and every rule has caught something real. Standing conditions: The effort the structure adds to a change is known; each rule has the mistake that justifies it; rules, records and checks that catch nothing are removed.
inputs: The check's history, time per check, files touched per change.
outputs: A periodic report of cost against catches.
usage_notes: Not built yet beyond the written weighing rule and the ratchet that shows how waivers, enabled rules and floors moved since a base commit.
change_driver: the system's own data model or code
